mapper.sql: SELECT fa.*, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.major, s.class_name, m.name AS mentor_name, m.title AS mentor_title, l.name AS lab_name, l.direction AS lab_direction, l.training_plan AS lab_training, m.research_direction AS mentor_direction FROM final_assignment fa JOIN student s ON s.id = fa.student_id JOIN mentor m ON m.id = fa.mentor_id JOIN lab l ON l.id = fa.lab_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO final_assignment (batch_id, student_id, application_id, mentor_id, lab_id, source, status, confirmed_at, remark) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{applicationId}, #{mentorId}, #{labId}, #{source}, #{status}, #{confirmedAt}, #{remark})
mapper.select: WHERE fa.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY fa.lab_id, fa.mentor_id, s.student_no
WHERE fa.batch_id = #{batchId} AND fa.status != 'REVOKED' ORDER BY fa.lab_id, fa.mentor_id, s.student_no
mapper.update: UPDATE final_assignment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE final_assignment SET status = #{status} WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND status != 'REVOKED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_assignment WHERE mentor_id = #{mentorId} AND batch_id = #{batchId} AND status != 'REVOKED'
